task-defaults:
    run-on-repo-type: [hg]
    platform: linux2404-64/opt
    always-target: true
    worker-type: t-linux-docker-amd
    worker:
        # A build image instead of the lint image m-c uses, because of the
        # comm-checkout requirement.
        docker-image: {in-tree: "debian12-amd64-build"}
        max-run-time: 3600
        env:
            MOZCONFIG: comm/mail/config/mozconfigs/linux64/source
    treeherder:
        kind: test
        tier: 1
    run:
        comm-checkout: true
        clone-with: hg
